General Remarks.

The land sold during the year amounted to 67,965.38 acres, which realized $62,942.82. The quantity of surrendered
land in the hands of the department was, approximately, 291,547.61 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of
Indian Lands sold, amounted to $400,498.91, a considerable portion of which has not yet become due.
